description: Translink Bus Stop List is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenDataNI. This data contains a list of all Metro and Ulsterbus Bus Stops across Northern Ireland. It includes all real and virtual bus stops. Updated 4th September 2026. Coverage: OpenDataNI. The portal files it under the publisher OpenDataNI. Its tags are Bus, Bus Service, Bus Stops, DRD, Department of Regional Development. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, DOCX, GEOJSON, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
